narrative: On the tables. The tables at home, in what is left of the dusk. One line is new. Nothing is written under it. No sum is in the margin. On the tables. He has not added the name of a play, or a penny, or a second sentence. The line sits by itself.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the line and left it alone.
